proposals.title: Feeling close to the people I live with
proposals.line: The people I share a home with know what's on my mind, because we talk about more than chores and schedules.

screen.reason: Names being known by the people I share a home with, beyond chores and schedules.

proposals.title: People who know what's really going on with me
proposals.line: A few people know what I'm worried about this month and what I'm looking forward to, because I've told them and they remember.

screen.reason: Names being known day to day, with a few people who hold my worries and hopes in mind.

overlaps.title: Someone I can be completely honest with
overlaps.reason: Being able to tell one person everything may be the same end state as having people who know what's going on with me.

overlaps.title: Someone who'd notice if I went quiet
overlaps.reason: People who know what's going on with me would likely notice if I went quiet, so one may contain the other.

proposals.title: Seeing people who know me in person
proposals.line: Most weeks I'm in the same room as a friend who knows me well, not just trading messages.

screen.reason: Names regular time in the same room as a friend who knows me well, not only messages.

overlaps.title: Talking most days with someone who knows me well
overlaps.reason: Both describe regular contact with people who know me, differing mainly in whether it is in person.

proposals.title: Time alone that doesn't feel lonely
proposals.line: When I spend an evening on my own, I enjoy the quiet, because I know I'll be talking with people who care about me soon.

screen.reason: Names solitude that feels restful because closeness with people who care is never far off.

proposals.title: Friends who get in touch with me first
proposals.line: My friends call or text me just to talk, so I'm not always the one who has to start.

screen.reason: Friends reaching out first is wanted so that I end up talking with people who know me, which is still this pain, so it reads as a means.

proposals.title: Someone who'd notice if I went quiet
proposals.line: If I didn't answer my phone for a few days, someone who knows me would notice and get in touch to check on me.

screen.reason: Someone checking on me when I go quiet fits No support ("I have no one to call when I need help") and Growing old alone just as well.
